title: The SecM arrest peptide traps a pre-peptide bond formation state of the ribosome.
authors: Gersteuer, Felix; Morici, Martino; Gabrielli, Sara; Fujiwara, Keigo; Safdari, Haaris A; Paternoga, Helge; Bock, Lars V; Chiba, Shinobu; Wilson, Daniel N
one_liner_zh: 该文研究核糖体翻译停滞肽SecM的结构与分子动力学机制，核心是核糖体-肽链互作，而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，仅MD方法可借鉴，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Nascent polypeptide chains can induce translational stalling to regulate gene expression. This is exemplified by the E. coli secretion monitor (SecM) arrest peptide that induces translational stalling to regulate expression of the downstream encoded SecA, an ATPase that co-operates with the SecYEG translocon to facilitate insertion of proteins into or through the cytoplasmic membrane. Here we present the structure of a ribosome stalled during translation of the full-length E. coli SecM arrest peptide at 2.0 A resolution. The structure reveals that SecM arrests translation by stabilizing the Pro-tRNA in the A-site, but in a manner that prevents peptide bond formation with the SecM-peptidyl-tRNA in the P-site. By employing molecular dynamic simulations, we also provide insight into how a pulling force on the SecM nascent chain can relieve the SecM-mediated translation arrest. Collectively, the mechanisms determined here for SecM arrest and relief are also likely to be applicable for a variety of other arrest peptides that regulate components of the protein localization machinery identified across a wide range of bacteria lineages.
abstract_zh: 新生多肽链可诱导翻译停滞以调控基因表达。这一现象以大肠杆菌分泌监测（SecM） arrest肽为例，该肽诱导翻译停滞，从而调控下游编码的SecA表达，SecA是一种ATP酶，与SecYEG转位子协同作用，促进蛋白质插入或穿过细胞质膜。在此，我们展示了在2.0 Å分辨率下，翻译全长大肠杆菌SecM arrest肽时停滞核糖体的结构。该结构揭示，SecM通过稳定A位点的Pro-tRNA来停滞翻译，但以一种阻止与P位点SecM-肽基-tRNA形成肽键的方式实现。通过采用分子动力学模拟，我们还提供了关于拉力作用于SecM新生链如何解除SecM介导的翻译停滞的见解。总体而言，此处确定的SecM停滞与解除机制，也可能适用于在广泛细菌谱系中鉴定出的、调控蛋白质定位机制组件的多种其他arrest肽。
